name: yao_open_prompts_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the yao_open_prompts capability.

prompts.name: marketing_campaign_prompt
prompts.template: Create a bilingual marketing message in {language_preference} that highlights {context_data}.
prompts.use_case: Creating effective AI prompts for bilingual marketing campaigns.

prompts.name: educational_content_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a bilingual educational explanation about {context_data} suitable for learners.
prompts.use_case: Generating educational prompts in both English and Chinese for learning applications.

prompts.name: content_creation_prompt
prompts.template: Write a bilingual creative text involving {context_data} for content generation.
prompts.use_case: Assisting content creators to produce bilingual text prompts for writing or ideation.

prompts.name: work_task_prompt
prompts.template: Formulate a bilingual prompt to assist with {context_data} in a professional setting.
prompts.use_case: Facilitating daily work-related AI prompt engineering across languages.
